import pytest
import jinja2

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_issue_1573():
    jinja_env = jinja2.Environment(enable_async=True)
    jinja_env.filters.update({'add_two': lambda x, y: [i + y for i in x]})

    template = jinja_env.from_string(
        "{% for item in (a.b|add_two(5))[:1] %}{{ item }}{% endfor %}"
    )
    data = {"a": {"b": [1, 2, 3]}}

    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as excinfo:
        await template.render_async(data)

    assert "coroutine' object is not subscriptable" in str(excinfo.value)

    # Test the alternative syntax that causes a SyntaxError
    template_syntax_error = jinja_env.from_string(
        "{% for item in a.b|add_two(5)[:1] %}{{ item }}{% endfor %}"
    )
    with pytest.raises(jinja2.exceptions.TemplateSyntaxError) as excinfo:
        # We need to compile the template to trigger the syntax error
        template_syntax_error.render(data)
    assert "expected token 'end of statement block', got '['" in str(excinfo.value)
